    Season 2 of
    The Pitt is currently releasing new episodes weekly on HBO Max every Thursday at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT. The fifteen-episode season premiered in January 2026, with episodes dropping weekly through mid-April, following the success of its 2025 debut. A third season has already been greenlit. 
    • Release Day/Time: Thursdays at 9 p.m. ET.
    • Latest Episodes: Episode 12 ("6 PM") was released on March 26, 2026.
    • Streaming Platform: HBO Max, with potential access via Hulu. 
    The show, featuring Noah Wyle, follows an inner-city hospital emergency department.

    AI Overview
    New episodes of "
    The Pitt" season 2 are released weekly on Thursdays at 9:00 p.m. ET (6:00 p.m. PT) on Max. The show, which follows a team of Pittsburgh medical professionals, drops these new episodes at the same time for streaming. 
    Key Details: 
    • Day: Thursdays
    • Time: 9:00 p.m. ET / 6:00 p.m. PT
    • Platform: Max (formerly HBO Max)
    • Latest Release: Episode 10 of Season 2 was released on March 12, 2026. 
    Note: The show is scheduled to continue releasing episodes through April 2026.
